terminal_observation.note: The foreground monitor observed the frozen process end and the independently audited raw result; it did not retain the child exit integer, so no exit code is asserted.

preflight.note: The frozen executor retained the preflight own hash in the full result; no standalone preflight file was retained.

build_identity.note: No standalone build-identity JSON was retained for the frozen D executor; the complete compiled identity is embedded in the raw result and source-freeze receipt.
